title.narrative: 2003 Convention - Support the preservation of ICH in Iraq

description.narrative: Iraq ratified the 2003 Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2010 and has since achieved the inscription of several elements on UNESCO’s Lists of Intangible Cultural Heritage, reflecting the country's rich and diverse living heritage traditions. Despite these achievements, many intangible cultural heritage practices face challenges related to displacement, social change, limited documentation, and the gradual loss of traditional knowledge and transmission mechanisms. UNESCO will provide technical support and guidance to the national and local authorities in Iraq and relevant cultural institutions, to strengthen the implementation of the 2003 Convention at both national and local levels. This support will focus on enhancing capacities for inventorying and documenting intangible cultural heritage, identifying and addressing urgent safeguarding needs, promoting community participation in heritage management, and contributing to ongoing efforts to preserve, celebrate, and transmit Iraq’s living heritage to future generations.
